claim: The personal fused-head construction with those requires a clausal modifier.
evidence_summary: CGEL’s own prose has about those present in the area affected by the storm (p. 1466) and to those present at the time (p. 1468), each with no antecedent set. Page 928 [13iia] has Those with a bus to catch don’t hesitate to leave.
finding: An AdjP or PP can also license the people reading. Non-finite clauses such as those arrested are consistent with the stated requirement.
proposed_wording: the construction requires a post-head dependent (a relative or non-finite clause, an AdjP such as present, or a PP such as with a bus to catch) and the plural form those
inference: Must personal those have a clausal modifier?

evidence.passage: §9.2(a), p. 414 [14i]. “the construction requires a clausal modifier and the plural form those.”
evidence.establishes: Counterexamples in the book’s own prose.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
